sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 當前 Pokémon GO 合眾 Pokédex 明列四季鹿／萌芽鹿各四種季節 form，以及輕飄飄／胖嘟嘟的普通（雄性）與 Female form；個別頁面確認同季節 Deerling 進化為同季節 Sawsbuck、Female Frillish 進化為 Female Jellicent。

boundary: #583 Vanillish -> #584 Vanilluxe remains materialized as a cross-batch incoming edge. Deerling evolves only to the matching-season Sawsbuck form; season value must not cross forms. Frillish and Jellicent male/female appearances are distinct Pokémon GO form identities here, and evolution remains gender-matched. #613 Cubchoo -> #614 Beartic is now materialized by the 614-643 candidate batch.
